meta_description:
3,962 likes, 98 comments - financebyanmoll on February 29, 2024: "TEDx was my dream!🥹🥹

It would be a LIE, if I say so.

Never have I ever had envisioned giving a TEDx talk for fraction of a second. I’m a firm believer in trusting the PROCESS.🍀✅

Rest everything are dividend of your efforts.

In the past 4 years, my journey has had its highs and lows, each one of which I cherish. 

Be it founding a startup in my 2nd year of college and failing at it or my interest in finance paying off while creating content, each step of the way I’ve learnt something new which sticks with me forever. 

Because of that whole journey riddled with mistakes and amends, I wasn’t ecstatic when I delivered my first TEDx speech, it felt natural to speak about my journey and what one could learn or avoid from it. 

I’m a big fan of ‘being honest with yourself’. In today’s world, there are many who follow the ‘fake it until you make it’ philosophy but one should be honest with himself/herself. 🤞

Let your actions speak for you. You can fake or you can lie to anyone about life, work, or business but you can’t lie to yourself. 

So staying honest and true to oneself and taking productive steps, one day at a time, you’ll be damn close to achieving anything in life.

But one thing for sure, the Tedx happened because of YOU guys!!! I Love you, and thank you for being a part of this community:)))🌟🍀🫰

#tedx #firsttedx #tedxtalks".
